text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Mohammed tells United Nations Earth Summit in New York of need to strike a balance between development and environment.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali to promote Morocco's economic policy in forum in Switzerland.
- Police seizes 800 kgs (176,000 pounds) of cocaine which washed up on a Casablanca shore.
- Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri expected in Morocco next week.
